purpose: Express a confident expectation or reassurance.
keywords: It will surely be sunny tomorrow.
My friend will surely be pleased.
If you practice, you will surely improve.
restrictions: It reflects confidence; it does not guarantee factual certainty.
mistake: Do not treat きっと as independent evidence.

segments.role: Express a confident expectation or reassurance. きっと + expected predicate.

examples.translation: It will surely be sunny tomorrow.
